what_it_is: maini precision products, part of the Maini Group of Bengaluru, is a precision-machining and tier-1/tier-2 aerospace supplier producing machined parts, sheet-metal assemblies, sub-assemblies, wiring harnesses and ground support equipment. The group's aerospace identity has consolidated under JK Maini Global Aerospace for its precision-aerospace business.
india_angle: Maini's aerospace entities supply the Airbus/Tata C-295 industrial ecosystem as tier-2 suppliers and broader global OEM supply chains from Bengaluru. The group's public profile has risen with the JK Maini restructuring and expansion of precision manufacturing capacity in Karnataka.
intelligence_assessment: Corporate evidence is solid through group sites and OEM programme pages, but platform-specific defence orders are not public. The C-295 tier-2 role and any HAL/DRDO subcontracting are the Indian military threads to verify in upcoming group disclosures.
sites: Bengaluru Bengaluru, Karnataka Precision machining; sheet-metal; sub-assemblies; ground support equipment; wiring harnesses. Tier-1 / Tier-2 supplier to Airbus for C-295.

faq.q: What does maini precision products supply?
faq.a: Precision-machined parts, sheet-metal and sub-assemblies, wiring harnesses and ground support equipment for aerospace customers.

faq.q: Is it part of a larger group?
faq.a: Yes - the Maini Group of Bengaluru; aerospace precision manufacturing is consolidated under JK Maini Global Aerospace.
